decisions.reason: Since it builds on the established offer and the firm has slack from industry growth, its still-uncertain early results do not yet trigger a shortfall that would justify dropping it.
Its results are uncertain but it is closely related to existing products, so the firm is likely to keep it while comparing its performance against aspirations.
As a flagship with its own page and a Red Dot award, it appears to meet or exceed aspirations despite being distant from the established offer.
